detail.title: A kind of fixture and production line
detail.abstract: The invention discloses a kind of fixture and production lines, to improve accuracy of the fixture when clamping components, to reduce fixture damage caused by components.Fixture in the present invention includes controller, position sensor, driving device, the clamping jaw being drivingly connected with driving device, and whether position sensor is installed on clamping jaw, needs to be taken components in clamping jaw for detecting；Controller is connect with position sensor and driving device, and for detecting in clamping jaw have when taking components according to position sensor, control driving device driving clamping jaw clamps components.
